displayTimeZone.settings.heading: Show times in
displayTimeZone.settings.description: Every time in waves, messages, decisions and notifications uses this zone. Screenshots show these times, so your local zone can reveal roughly where you are.
displayTimeZone.option.utc.description: The same for everyone · {time} now. Times in 6529 won't show your zone.
displayTimeZone.search.label: Search time zones
displayTimeZone.search.placeholder: City or zone, such as Lisbon
displayTimeZone.search.empty: No time zones match “{query}”. Try a city, such as Lisbon, or a zone, such as Europe/Lisbon.
displayTimeZone.preview.label: Preview
displayTimeZone.footnote: Saved on this device only, not with your profile. Times outside your local zone always show the zone name. A screenshot can still show your device's own clock. For a single screenshot, use the clock button in any wave instead.
displayTimeZone.switch.label: Time display: {zone}
displayTimeZone.switch.heading: Show times in
displayTimeZone.switch.note: Lasts until you close this tab or the app, then times go back to your setting. Your device's own clock still shows local time.
displayTimeZone.switch.preferencesLink: Always use a time zone in Preferences
displayTimeZone.chip.label: Times in {zone}
displayTimeZone.menu.useUtc: Show times in UTC for now
displayTimeZone.menu.useLocal: Show times in local time for now
